description:
The University of Oulu awards scholarships to non-EU/EEA master's applicants automatically during admission — no separate application is needed. Waivers range from 50% to 100% of tuition, and the strongest candidates can receive a 100% waiver combined with a yearly stipend. The application window for international programmes typically runs from November to mid-January.

Programme Highlights

  • No separate scholarship form — assessed with the admission application
  • 50-100% tuition waivers, with stipend-linked awards for top candidates
  • Finnish joint application window in winter for a September start
  • Strong technology and natural-science programme portfolio

Who Should Apply

Non-EU/EEA applicants to Oulu's international master's programmes; eligibility follows admission to an eligible programme with tuition liability.

Funding and Costs

Oulu scholarships range from 50% to 100% tuition waivers, with a limited number of 100% waivers plus annual stipends for top-ranked applicants. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the Oulu scholarships page for the current window and criteria, then submit your study application through Studyinfo during the window. Key deadline information: Scholarships are awarded with admission; the international master's application window typically runs November – mid-January.
